candidates.title: What this desert city can teach the world about tackling heat deaths
candidates.description: Maricopa County in Arizona has some of the hottest temperatures, but it has reduced the number of heat-related deaths.

candidates.title: OpenAI’s letter to Governor Newsom on harmonized regulation
candidates.description: We’ve just sent a letter to Gov. Gavin Newsom calling for California to lead the way in harmonizing state-based AI regulation with national—and, by virtue of US leadership, emerging global—standards.

candidates.title: Stability AI Open Sources 'StableLM 3B' for Edge Devices: Lightweight LLM with RAG Optimizations
candidates.description: A new 3B parameter model designed for on-device inference with quantized retrieval embeddings, enabling privacy-preserving RAG applications on phones and IoT.
